attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his signed open letter. He presents the five predictions as his, adapted from work with Ernie Davis, and endorses them as bet terms.

semantics.note: 'Will not' is an unhedged forecast. The normalisation keeps the 2029 horizon, the reliability and bug-free bar, the >10,000-line threshold, both input routes, and the library-gluing exclusion. The five-item bet structure doesn't make this item conditional.

contract.note: Reading the horizon as 'during 2029' (end 2029-12-31) is fair. But 'reliably' and 'bug-free' have no test procedure, and the contract itself says a reviewer must fix one before scoring. The result could therefore turn on a test the speaker never supplied. The 'false' flag should be true.

output.rationale: This is a scored forecast with a deadline of 2029-12-31, which is after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date. The contract has no early-resolution rule, and the evidence packet is empty, so no conclusive event exists. Under the policy the forecast can't be scored before its deadline, so the outcome is unresolved and the horizon is not_due.
